table.title: Equivalent R and SPSS syntax
rows:
df <- read.csv("review-survey.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c('', 'NA', 'null', 'NULL'))
items <- c("turf_a", "turf_b", "turf_c", "turf_d")
M <- as.matrix(df[, items, drop=FALSE]); M[is.na(M)] <- 0; M <- M > 0
n <- nrow(M)
reach <- function(idx) mean(apply(M[, idx, drop=FALSE], 1, any))
freq <- function(idx) sum(M[, idx, drop=FALSE]) / n
k <- min(2, length(items))
chosen <- integer(0); remaining <- seq_along(items)
for (step in seq_len(k)) {
  scores <- sapply(remaining, function(i) reach(c(chosen, i)))
  pick <- remaining[order(-scores, remaining)][1]
  chosen <- c(chosen, pick); remaining <- setdiff(remaining, pick)
}
cat(sprintf('reach=%.16g\n', reach(chosen)))
cat(sprintf('frequency=%.16g\n', freq(chosen)))
